senses.def: to like something very much
senses.ex: I love pizza with lots of cheese.
senses.exPt: Eu adoro pizza com bastante queijo.

senses.def: a very strong feeling of liking someone
senses.ex: Their love grew stronger every year.
senses.exPt: O amor deles ficou mais forte a cada ano.

senses.def: very beautiful or attractive
senses.ex: What a lovely dress! Where did you buy it?
senses.exPt: Que vestido lindo! Onde você comprou?

senses.def: very pleasant or enjoyable
senses.ex: It was a lovely day at the beach.
senses.exPt: Foi um dia ótimo na praia.

senses.def: kind and friendly
senses.ex: Your mother is a lovely person.
senses.exPt: Sua mãe é uma pessoa muito querida.

senses.def: a person who enjoys something very much
senses.ex: My dad is a big music lover.
senses.exPt: Meu pai é um grande amante de música.

senses.def: in a way that shows love or great care
senses.ex: She looked lovingly at the baby in her arms.
senses.exPt: Ela olhou carinhosamente para o bebê em seus braços.

senses.def: not high, or less than usual in amount
senses.ex: The prices in this shop are very low.
senses.exPt: Os preços desta loja são muito baixos.

senses.def: almost finished, used about a battery
senses.ex: My phone battery is low, can I charge it here?
senses.exPt: A bateria do meu celular está fraca, posso carregar aqui?

senses.def: to move something down
senses.ex: Please lower your voice; the baby is asleep.
senses.exPt: Por favor, abaixe a voz; o bebê está dormindo.

senses.def: to make something less in amount or level
senses.ex: The shop lowered its prices after Christmas.
senses.exPt: A loja reduziu os preços depois do Natal.

senses.def: below another thing of the same type; nearer the bottom
senses.ex: Put your shoes on the lower shelf.
senses.exPt: Coloque seus sapatos na prateleira de baixo.

senses.def: an area of low, flat land
senses.ex: The lowlands near the river often flood in winter.
senses.exPt: As planícies perto do rio costumam inundar no inverno.

senses.def: always supporting a person, team or company
senses.ex: Dogs are very loyal to their owners.
senses.exPt: Os cachorros são muito leais aos donos.

senses.def: the quality of always supporting a person or group
senses.ex: Dogs are famous for their loyalty to their owners.
senses.exPt: Os cães são famosos pela lealdade aos donos.

senses.def: good things that happen by chance
senses.ex: Good luck on your exam tomorrow!
senses.exPt: Boa sorte na prova amanhã!

senses.def: used to say that something good happened by chance
senses.ex: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident.
senses.exPt: Felizmente, ninguém se machucou no acidente.

senses.def: having good things happen to you by chance
senses.ex: You won again? You're so lucky!
senses.exPt: Você ganhou de novo? Você é muito sortudo!

senses.def: bringing good luck
senses.ex: Seven has always been my lucky number.
senses.exPt: Sete sempre foi o meu número da sorte.

senses.def: producing a lot of money
senses.ex: Selling coffee online has become a lucrative business.
senses.exPt: Vender café pela internet virou um negócio lucrativo.

senses.def: so silly or unreasonable that it makes you laugh
senses.ex: It's ludicrous to pay that much for a cup of coffee.
senses.exPt: É ridículo pagar tanto por uma xícara de café.

senses.def: in a way that is so silly or extreme it is unreasonable
senses.ex: The concert tickets were ludicrously expensive this year.
senses.exPt: Os ingressos do show estavam ridiculamente caros este ano.

senses.def: the bags and suitcases you take when you travel
senses.ex: How much luggage are you taking on the trip?
senses.exPt: Quanta bagagem você vai levar na viagem?

senses.def: the meal you eat in the middle of the day
senses.ex: What do you want for lunch today?
senses.exPt: O que você quer de almoço hoje?

senses.def: the time in the middle of the day when people eat lunch
senses.ex: I'll call you at lunchtime.
senses.exPt: Eu te ligo na hora do almoço.

senses.def: one of the two organs in your chest used for breathing
senses.ex: Smoking can cause serious damage to your lungs.
senses.exPt: Fumar pode causar danos graves aos pulmões.

senses.def: with a lot of healthy green plants
senses.ex: The valley was full of lush green fields.
senses.exPt: O vale era cheio de campos verdes e exuberantes.

senses.def: strong sexual desire
senses.ex: It wasn't love between them, it was just lust.
senses.exPt: Não era amor entre eles, era só desejo.

senses.def: a very strong wish to have something, such as power or money
senses.ex: His lust for power eventually destroyed the company.
senses.exPt: A sede de poder dele acabou destruindo a empresa.

senses.def: very comfortable and expensive
senses.ex: They stayed in a luxurious hotel by the sea.
senses.exPt: Eles ficaram em um hotel luxuoso à beira-mar.

senses.def: great comfort that costs a lot of money
senses.ex: They stayed in a luxury hotel by the beach.
senses.exPt: Eles ficaram num hotel de luxo perto da praia.

senses.def: the words of a song
senses.ex: I don't know the lyrics of this song.
senses.exPt: Eu não sei a letra desta música.

senses.def: the words of a song
senses.ex: I love this song, but I can't understand the lyrics.
senses.exPt: Adoro essa música, mas não consigo entender a letra.
